Investigation from open sources and public registers: companies, people and their links, every claim traced to its source.

The concept behind it: [OSINT](@/glossary/osint.md).

Services that draw on it: [Digital investigation and OSINT dossiers](@/services/digital-investigation.md) and [Reputation intelligence and adverse-media monitoring](@/services/reputation-intelligence.md).

Practised with: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md), [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md), [Tailwind CSS](@/glossary/tailwind-css.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md) and [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md).

Public work whose own words show it: [sig](https://gitlab.com/korczis/sig), [crisis-map](https://github.com/korczis/crisis-map), [osint-case-ratcliffe-moscow-2026](https://github.com/korczis/osint-case-ratcliffe-moscow-2026) and [data-atlas](https://github.com/korczis/data-atlas).

It was applied in client work in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group; the use cases below give the principle and the intent, without names or numbers.

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
